name: Check a memorable crossing against the whole cord

uses.action: Compare a memorable fog crossing with the long knot cord before commissioning the lookout.

name: Test the light before accepting the first price

uses.action: Cover the chalked price and look at the two pools of light before making a loan. Reintroduce the eighty-bit starting price.

name: Trace the crossing behind a missed shift

uses.action: Hang the ferry times beside the rota. Follow the return address on the missed shift before deciding who should cover it.

name: Calibrate a fitting forecast against a clay impression

uses.action: Compare the maker’s predicted contacts with clay impressions of a familiar gear and an unfamiliar one. The experienced fitter tries a new jig too.

name: Judge a lift with the information its maker had

uses.action: Pass the previously successful arm through a separate and assembled load before judging the evidence of its first lift.

name: Try a load that combines separately tested parts

uses.action: Try the kettle and lid individually and together. Watch the swinging lid catch on an otherwise serviceable arm.

name: Open the lanes inside a district total

uses.action: Slide the lanes apart. A district total can be within the wait target even when households in the smaller lane are late.

name: Check who was excluded from a sweeping claim

uses.action: Cover both crew badges, follow the stretched cord, and consider the green watcher’s proposed exception for a rushing member.

name: Test a boundary drawn after the boats came home

uses.action: Lift the drawn ring to recover the map edges and replace the return log with the departure log. Choose where a fresh observation will be made.

name: Check a voyage beyond its order in the log

uses.action: Set dates in order and compare boats from one crossing. Try the damp patch under the rail before assigning the captain another job.

name: Find a second explanation for a silent register

uses.action: Put the lamp underneath the sill and bring the listening cup near the peg. An empty sketch box leaves the source of the first sound uncertain.
Take the runner’s route and check who could enter an appeal. A clean book cannot establish universal access to the late hearing.

name: Decide which quantity a stable scale measures

uses.action: Weigh empty wicker and fruit separately. The same stable reading can answer the porter’s load question and mislead the buyer about fruit alone.

name: Recover observations that missed the display

uses.action: Open the cleaning sack and follow the dull path. The returns that could be displayed differ from the birds that were present.

name: Distinguish a purposeful instruction from a working trace

uses.action: Compare the manager’s signed concealment order with the runner’s delivery slip. Two signatures establish different kinds of involvement.
Bring the original cut and the later repair under the council lamp. Match each with the job its own work order describes.

name: Check who could return a lantern at all

uses.action: Bring the departure and homecoming sheets together to see which crews were asked for a lantern at all.

name: Compare a memorable voyage with another crossing

uses.action: Match boats from the same crossing and inspect the damp hull before treating a good return as a trial of the surface.

name: Change the seat before interpreting a performance

uses.action: Play the flight from the front slit and the wing, then move the caller’s cue. A shared performance makes different evidence available to each row.

name: Check what a title and a repeated observation each establish

uses.action: Cover the grand title and compare the incision with the job book. Decide whether a repeat or a corrected credit would help the next visitor check it.

name: Restore the words before an archive excerpt

uses.action: Wind to the breath before the excerpt and inspect the sleeve before letting the take travel. One signed room permission has a narrower scope than the public clipping.

name: Separate authority to sign from knowledge of the marks

uses.action: Place the conservator’s seal against the actual job assignment. The person who can authorise a label and the person who made the scraping can differ.
